# AIGC Reducer

[中文首页](../README.md) · [Installation by tool](INSTALL.md) · [CLI reference](CLI.md) · [Before/after examples](../examples/README.md)

Edit the wording of existing Chinese academic DOCX files, using a detection report or user-selected sections to define the scope. Scripts locate paragraphs, align replies, check selected invariants, and write a new Word file. The host model performs the rewrite.

**The default deliverable is one revised DOCX.** Checks stay internal. No audit report, comparison document, or JSON report is generated by default.

![Synthetic before/after example, not a detector benchmark](../assets/demo.png)

## Get started

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Longfei-Tao/aigc-reducer.git
cd aigc-reducer
python -m pip install -r skills/aigc-reducer/requirements.txt
```

Copy the entire `skills/aigc-reducer/` directory into the skill location supported by your tool, or use its skill import interface. See the [tool-specific guide](INSTALL.md) for Windows PowerShell and macOS/Linux instructions.

| Tool | Installation route |
|---|---|
| WorkBuddy | Import a local skill package in its Skills interface |
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/skills/aigc-reducer/` |
| Codex | `~/.agents/skills/aigc-reducer/` |
| Cursor | Shared `.agents/skills` location or project `.cursor/skills` |
| Gemini CLI | Shared `.agents/skills` location or `.gemini/skills` |
| GitHub Copilot | Personal `.agents/skills` or project `.github/skills` |
| OpenCode | Shared `.agents/skills` location or project `.opencode/skills` |
| OpenClaw | Active workspace `skills/` or `~/.openclaw/skills/` |
| Text-only web assistants | Local CLI plus manual text transfer |

Locations follow vendor documentation checked on 2026-10-31; this is not a claim of end-to-end testing in every client. Automated use requires file access and Python execution. Remote agents need dependencies and authorized file access in their own environment. CC Switch users should install through CC Switch instead of overwriting generated client copies.

Provide the original DOCX, the detection report, and this request:

Before sending, turn off web search and enable a supported thinking/reasoning mode in the current client. This is the maintainer's recommended DeepSeek workflow, not a measured cross-model optimum. Installing the skill cannot toggle these settings. See the [runtime settings guide](../skills/aigc-reducer/references/runtime-settings.md) (Chinese). The skill avoids retrieval during rewriting and reports unavailable setting information honestly; cloud inference still requires a network connection.

```text
Use aigc-reducer to revise the Chinese wording in the sections marked in this report.
Preserve facts, numbers, citations, and the strength of the conclusions.
Run checks internally and return only the revised Word file, without extra reports.
```

## Examples and evidence

The [examples](../examples/README.md) contain three synthetic before/after pairs. Their character counts, punctuation counts, numeric tokens, and citations can be inspected. They are editorial demonstrations, not measured detector results or factual research evidence.

No paired detector reports are currently available. We do not claim a score reduction or guarantee passage through a detector. A rule-check pass does not prove semantic equivalence.

## Limits

- The original is preserved and a new output name is required.
- Paragraph properties are retained, but local character formatting and pagination can change.
- Tables, headers, footers, text boxes, and note bodies are outside the editing scope. Complex paragraph objects are excluded.
- The Python scripts do not make network calls; the host model may use a cloud service.
- Review the output, follow your institution's disclosure rules, and retain legally required generated-content labels.

## Development and license

```bash
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

The current local regression suite has 42 tests. CI is configured for Linux and Windows with Python 3.9 and 3.12; consult the workflow status for actual CI results. These tests do not verify client switches, model connections, or detector performance.
